ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, estimated at approximately 0.10:0.90 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast features include a white circular ring in the upper-right quadrant, multiple vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear streaks concentrated on the inner right lobe, and scattered punctate white spots on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable peaks and valleys are most pronounced near the distal tips, showing high-amplitude pixel variations corresponding to encrusted material.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters at both distal tips (consistent with barnacle colonization). A single, high-contrast white circular ring ('O' shape) is visible on the upper mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant vertical white rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) on the inner right lobe. Finer diagonal scratches are visible on the mid-left lobe and near the peduncle interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular protrusion-like trauma or encrustation on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Deep vertical scarring on the lower right lobe near the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique near-perfect white ring-shaped mark ('O' scar) located in the upper interior quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
